# LUMAA HOME™

> The premier independent luxury home decor, period architectural restoration, and bespoke joinery editorial magazine for British design enthusiasts.

## Core Navigation
- [Home](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/): The main editorial magazine homepage.
- [Sitemap](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML sitemap.
- [RSS Feed](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/rss.xml): Real-time XML syndication newsfeed.
- [About Us](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/about): Editorial masthead, mission, and British architecture credentials.
- [Contact](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/contact): Editorial inquiries and press contacts.

## Design Categories & Rooms
- [Living Room](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/category/living-room): Sophisticated layouts, chimney breast alcoves, fireplace styling, and warm British palettes for your primary entertaining space.
- [Bedroom](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/category/bedroom): Serene master suites, bespoke linen headboards, layered acoustic textures, and restful sanctuaries for UK homes.
- [Kitchen](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/category/kitchen): Handcrafted Shaker cabinetry, larder pantries, unlacquered brass hardware, and honed stone worktops for the culinary heart of the home.
- [Bathroom](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/category/bathroom): Compact ensuite makeovers, freestanding cast iron baths, microcement wetrooms, and spa-inspired finishes.
- [Garden](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/category/garden): Cotswold stone courtyards, heritage pergolas, outdoor dining terraces, and botanical styling for UK climates.
- [INTERIORS](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/category/interiors): Inside premier architectural residences across London, Edinburgh, and the Cotswolds with leading UK interior designers.
- [DIY](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/category/diy): Expert, step-by-step masterclasses: wall panelling, timber restoration, lime plastering, and furniture revamps.
- [Buying Guides](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/category/buying-guides): Critical investment reviews: hardwood sofas, handmade mattresses, heritage paint formulas, and statement lighting.

## Published Editorial Guides
- [Choosing The Best Fire Pit Out For Your English Garden](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/choosing-the-best-fire-pit-out-for-your-english-garden): Expert guide to selecting a fire pit out for British gardens.
- [Applying Self Adhesive Wall Tiles In Modern British Homes](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/applying-self-adhesive-wall-tiles-in-modern-british-homes): Master the application of self adhesive wall tiles for instant kitchen and bathroom transformations without messy mortar or professional trades.
- [Inspiring Home Interior Design Ideas for British Properties](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/inspiring-home-interior-design-ideas-for-british-properties): A practical editorial guide on implementing sustainable materials, exact spatial clearances, and trade-level joinery specs across British homes.
- [How to Choose a Master Bedroom Chair for Timeless Comfort](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/how-to-choose-a-master-bedroom-chair-for-timeless-comfort): A bespoke bedroom chair elevates private suite design by combining tailored ergonomics with acoustic dampening fabrics and solid hardwood joinery.
- [How to Choose the Best Kitchen Bin for Built In Cabinets](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/how-to-choose-the-best-kitchen-bin-for-built-in-cabinets): A refined technical analysis on selecting high-performance integrated and freestanding kitchen bin systems for bespoke British interiors.
- [Choosing a High Specification Garden Storage Box for Timber](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/choosing-a-high-specification-garden-storage-box-for-timber): An engineering led guide to selecting and maintaining a weatherproof timber garden storage box for refined outdoor spaces.
- [How to Layer Living Room Lights for Warm Architectural Depth](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/how-to-layer-living-room-lights-for-warm-architectural-depth): A technical guide to layering living room lights using precise spatial elevations, proper driver specs, and warm colour temperatures.
- [Mastering Kitchen Cabinets: Design, Joinery and Proportion](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/mastering-kitchen-cabinets-design-joinery-and-proportion): A practical guide to designing, specifying, and maintaining high-performance kitchen cabinets using authentic timber joinery and British architectural standards.
- [Finding The Ideal 3 Bedroom House For Rent In Britain](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/finding-the-ideal-3-bedroom-house-for-rent-in-britain): Navigating the property market requires an understanding of structural proportions and residential tenancy agreements.
- [Stunning Transformations Using Stick On Bathroom Tiles](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/stunning-transformations-using-stick-on-bathroom-tiles): Transform your bathroom using expert peel and stick tile installation methods.
- [Floor Lamps for Living Room Layouts An Architectural Guide](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/floor-lamps-for-living-room-layouts-architectural-guide): Expert advice on styling and placing floor lamps in living room seating layouts.
- [How to Select a Quality Kitchen Sink for Modern UK Homes](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/how-to-select-a-quality-kitchen-sink-for-modern-uk-homes): Expert guide to selecting quality kitchen sinks for British homes.
- [Designing Serene Spaces With Premium Green Bathroom Tiles](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/designing-serene-spaces-with-premium-green-bathroom-tiles): Expert architectural guide on specifying green bathroom tiles covering British wet zones and waterproofing.
- [Creating a DIY Art Club Space for Collaborative Studios](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/creating-a-diy-art-club-space-for-collaborative-studios): Build a functional communal workspace with expert timber joinery and layout advice.
- [Designing the Safe Baby Bath Tub Zone for Modern Bathrooms](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/designing-the-safe-baby-bath-tub-zone-for-modern-bathrooms): Expert design advice for creating a safe modern baby bath tub zone with professional UK trade insights.
- [Refined Bedroom Decor Ideas for Timeless British Houses](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/refined-bedroom-decor-ideas-for-timeless-british-houses): Discover expert British interior design advice for crafting elegant traditional spaces.
- [Transform British Interiors With Large Bathroom Tiles Now](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/transform-british-interiors-with-large-bathroom-tiles-now): Discover how large bathroom tiles transform compact British rooms with fewer grout lines and bright stone aesthetics.
- [Sky Garden London Principles for Elevated Botanical Spaces](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/sky-garden-london-principles-for-elevated-botanical-spaces): Learn expert horticultural techniques inspired by sky garden london for your own elevated botanical spaces.
- [Choosing Rugs For Living Room Spaces With Style](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/choosing-rugs-for-living-room-spaces-with-style): Master the art of selecting and sizing rugs for living room spaces with expert insights on textile construction and spatial proportion.
- [Selecting Craft Kitchen Worktops for Modern British Homes](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/selecting-craft-kitchen-worktops-for-modern-british-homes): A practical guide to choosing kitchen worktops that blend structural integrity, British craftsmanship, and refined surface aesthetics.
- [Selecting Bathroom Tiles for Refined Architectural Homes](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/selecting-bathroom-tiles-for-refined-architectural-homes): A technical editorial guide to specifying durable, slip-resistant bathroom tiles engineered for high-performance British residential wet spaces.
- [Crafting Bespoke DIY Kitchens: The British Fitting Guide](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/crafting-bespoke-diy-kitchens-the-british-fitting-guide): Achieving bespoke craftsmanship in self-installed cabinetry requires rigorous attention to structural tolerances, architectural proportion, and premium timber joinery.
- [Crafting Timeless Spaces With Quality Bedroom Furniture](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/crafting-timeless-spaces-with-quality-bedroom-furniture): Thoughtfully chosen bedroom furniture elevates architectural proportions and brings lasting British craftsmanship into your home.
- [Architectural Design Principles for the Luxury Bath Tub](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/architectural-design-principles-luxury-bath-tub): An architectural masterclass on specifying luxury bath tubs, covering enameled cast iron, stone composites, subfloor joist engineering, and hydraulic plumbing standards.

## Masthead Editors
- [Sarah Jenkins](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/author/sarah-jenkins): London Interior Stylist and Joinery Specialist. Sarah works directly with British artisan cabinetmakers and joiners to create bespoke alcove cabinetry, handmade Shaker pantries, and tactile bedroom suites.
- [Eleanor Vance](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/author/eleanor-vance): Senior Architectural and Restoration Editor. Architectural historian and senior editor with over 15 years of experience documenting Grade I and Grade II listed townhouse restorations across London and Edinburgh. Eleanor specialises in Victorian plasterwork preservation, Georgian joinery, and sustainable lime plasters.
- [Marcus Cole](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/author/marcus-cole): Interiors and Period Living Editor. Former design director at an established Mayfair architectural studio, Marcus leads LUMAA HOME’s coverage of historic fireplaces, proportion rules, and curated living room furniture.
- [Oliver Sinclair](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/author/oliver-sinclair): Master Joiner and Period Restoration Consultant. Master joiner and historic woodwork specialist with over twenty years of experience restoring timber framing, bespoke panelling, and traditional box sash windows across historic British residences.
- [Clara Davenport](https://www.lumaahome.co.uk/author/clara-davenport): Lead Interior Architect and Lighting Designer. Interior architect and lighting specialist known for harmonising natural daylight with architectural fixtures in heritage townhouses and luxury modern extensions across Bath and London.
